Name: Tiny Beach Farm - for 1.6.14 SV
Author: PichuYang
Description:
[b][IMPORTANT][/b]
I no longer allow users to edit this file since Jan 17, 2025.
Unless it is necessary such as bug fixes, with my permission.

This is the one that has granted permission, which added Greenhouse and Fishing space:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24126

[[b]Description[/b]]
Hello, this is my own very first mod for a game!

Tiny Beach Farm adds a custom farm, which has limited planting space, no sprinklers for most area, and no space for fishing!
Seems like Grandpa's farm also has no space for Greenhouse too!

It is suitable for singleplayer, challenge and minimalist playstyle.
[i](Okay I admit it, this farm is initially designed to torture myself. XD)
[/i]The TV will no longer be sent by mail. Instead, it is operational right in house!
If you have issue placing Crab Pots, try using keyboard.

Enjoy!

[b][Installation][/b]
- Unzip the file and place the main folder in StardewValley > Mods
- Check the little arrow when attempting to create new farm.

[b][Known Issues]
[/b]- This map does not work with any other map that does not change map ID, when I was given permission to edit.
- There is currently no code that stops receiving mails caused by other mods.
- Mailbox is now default thanks to Robin able to move Farmhouse PLUS Mailbox in 1.6.

Downloads.Description: Clean up, removed custom Mailbox instances, added TV, and removing mail.
